message.content:
## Tracing the Lineage Chain

Let me map out all the relationships systematically:

| Given Statement | Interpretation |
|----------------|----------------|
| Peter is Sara's descendant | Sara → ... → **Peter** |
| Christian is Richard's descendant | Richard → ... → **Christian** |
| Peter is George's ancestor | Peter → ... → **George** |
| Maria is Diane's descendant | Diane → ... → **Maria** |
| Richard is George's descendant | George → ... → **Richard** |
| Maria is Sara's ancestor | Maria → ... → **Sara** |
| Victoria is Christian's descendant | Christian → ... → **Victoria** |

## Building the Full Chain

Connecting these links step by step:

$$\text{Diane} \to \text{Maria} \to \text{Sara} \to \text{Peter} \to \text{George} \to \text{Richard} \to \text{Christian} \to \text{Victoria}$$

## Conclusion

Following the complete chain, **Diane** is an ancestor of **Victoria**, which means **Victoria is Diane's descendant**.

<ANSWER>3</ANSWER>
